curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Something restless walks the quiet grounds of Santa Lucía, but what grievance is this vengeful presence desperate to settle?
curatedMovie.description: In 1939, during the final days of the Spanish Civil War, young Carlos arrives at the Santa Lucía orphanage, where he encounters new friends, rivals, and a shadowy presence stalking the halls in search of revenge.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A slow, somber ghost story with heavy historical weight and steady suspense, tailored for absorbed solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Guillermo del Toro pairs historical devastation with eerie gothic suspense, turning an isolated orphanage into a heavy, emotionally charged thriller.
